summary: Expose the literal reference table as typed package data, retaining the reference metadata limits.

identity.relation: Stored reference table to typed reference data
identity.definition: Return the exact 40-row four-column reference whpdat and its kxwhp, kzwhp, wrwhp and wiwhp columns.
identity.model: Stored external-solver reference observations; not an executable solver.
identity.geometry: The reference kx column is the literal constant 0.5.
identity.coordinates: Column units and complete run normalization are not stated in the reference.
identity.boundary: No interpolation, fit or physical inference.
assumptions: Missing source physical metadata remains unknown.

inputs.name: transport
inputs.description: Optional explicit native executor; None uses the packaged resource closure.
inputs.constraints: Requires a compatible external Octave runtime. No original checkout or network is consulted.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: NativeResult state whpdat plus kxwhp,kzwhp,wrwhp,wiwhp literal column arrays.
outputs.constraints: No units, equilibrium or solver version are inferred; receipt is execution metadata.

preconditions: Finite inputs satisfying the declared units and shapes.
excluded: A new solver run, calibration oracle, or inferred physical units/equilibrium.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError or a missing required mapping key rejects invalid inputs.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Dependency, numerical-library, or native-runtime errors propagate; no silent alternate provider.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial result is returned on failure.

example.description: Read the stored table without assigning unstated units.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.dispersion.reference import reference_table
r = reference_table()
assert r.state["whpdat"].shape == (40, 4)
example.expected: NOT_RUN (environment): the example requires GNU Octave on Linux amd64; this macOS checkout has no octave executable, so NativeExecutionError is expected and no scientific result is claimed.

scope: Literal table identity and typed column mapping.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct contract tests and the declared finite cases bound the relation only where their numeric gates apply; native Octave execution requires GNU Octave on Linux amd64 and is NOT_RUN in this macOS checkout.
known_limitations: Source units, complete equilibrium and run metadata are unspecified.
The native example and full native-path qualification require GNU Octave on Linux amd64; the run on this macOS host is NOT_RUN.
